preset.description: Start a repo of the monorepo standard. create-nx-workspace runs it.

init.description: Add the root files of the monorepo standard. Safe to run again.

node-app.description: Add a Hono backend: one ESM esbuild bundle, evlog, a zod env, an sdk-it client and a Dockerfile whose image reports its commit.

react-app.description: Add a React Router SPA on Vite, with Tailwind, the React Compiler and Vitest component tests.

pair.description: Pair a react-app with a node-app: the web gets the generated client, and the api serves the web build and puts it in its image.

ui-package.description: Add a buildable React package with a Vite library build, types and a development export condition.

prisma.description: Add a Postgres db package on Prisma 7 and @prisma/adapter-pg, with a migration image and a test helper, and connect a node-app to it.

dokploy.description: Deliver a node-app to Dokploy by GitOps: an OpenTofu project in infra/ with the compose, optional Postgres and a private registry, and the CI and deploy workflows that call zukhruf's tofu-apply, dokploy-deploy and wait-for-health.

auth.description: Add better-auth to a node-app and the db package it is wired to: an auth factory, the routes under /api/auth, the environment, the models of better-auth, and auth:generate and auth:check targets.
